checkoutSubtitle: Configure checkout form fields, quick order on the product page, and display order.
enableCheckoutForm: Enable Checkout Form on Product Page
enableCheckoutFormDesc: Show a quick checkout form directly on the product page for faster purchasing.
formOrderDesc: Control the display order of the quick order form on the product page.
formFieldsDesc: Customize which fields appear in the quick order form on the product page.
integrationDesc: Enable or disable the quick order form on the product page to appear directly after basic product options.
enableCheckoutFormLabel: Enable order form on product page
enableCheckoutFormHelp: When enabled, a `pdp-checkout` section will appear as a quick order form on the product page. You can control its order and fields independently from the full checkout page.
formOrderPlacementDesc: Determines whether the form appears before or after the product description on the product page.
formOrderSurfaceModeDesc: Choose between a standalone form, or merge it with the buy box (variants and purchase buttons).
pdpFullNameDesc: Customer name in the quick order form on the product page.
pdpPhoneDesc: Primary contact number to confirm the order from the product page.
pdpGovernorateDesc: Used to calculate shipping within the quick form if visible.
pdpAddressDesc: The address that will be sent with the quick order from the product page.
pdpAlternatePhoneDesc: Optional additional field for backup contact with the customer.
checkoutFullFieldsDesc: Control the information the store asks for on the full checkout page only.
fullNameDesc: Request full customer name for easy communication and delivery.
phoneNumberDesc: The number to contact for order confirmation.
emailDesc: Send order status notifications and invoice details.
shippingDesc: Specify location details to ensure correct product delivery.
cityDesc: Determine the geographic region to calculate shipping cost.
addressDesc: Building number, street name, and any landmarks.
additionalDesc: Enable or disable extra fields on the checkout page.
paymentMethodDesc: Show available payment options (Cash, Card, etc.)
notesDesc: Allow the customer to add special delivery instructions.
